detail.body:
## What does this PR do?

Refactor PR number handling and environment configuration in Auto Swap Labels.

## Details

- Consolidate PR number checks and output formatting.
- Declare per-step inputs using `env` entries.

## Tested

- `actionlint .github/workflows/auto-swap-labels.yml .github/workflows/review-trigger.yml` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` — passed; no Python files changed.

## Code provenance

Implemented within this repository; no code copied from other repositories.
detail.title: refactor(ci): streamline label workflow inputs

files.patch:
@@ -41,17 +41,27 @@ jobs:
 
       - name: Set PR number
         id: pr
+        env:
+          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          ARTIFACT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.get-pr.outcome }}
+          EVENT_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
         run: |
-          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_run" ]; then
-            if [ "${{ steps.get-pr.outcome }}" != "success" ]; then
+          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_run" ]; then
+            if [ "$ARTIFACT_OUTCOME" != "success" ]; then
               echo "No approval artifact found — review was not an approval. Skipping."
               exit 0
             fi
-            echo "number=$(cat pr-number/number)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+            pr_number=$(cat pr-number/number)
           else
-            echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+            pr_number="$EVENT_PR_NUMBER"
           fi
 
+          if [[ ! "$pr_number" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
+            echo "::error::Invalid PR number"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          printf 'number=%s\n' "$pr_number" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
       - name: Check out repository code
         if: steps.pr.outputs.number
         uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
@@ -69,7 +79,7 @@ jobs:
 
       - name: Run Auto Swap Labels
         if: steps.pr.outputs.number
-        run: |
-          export GH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.PAT }}
-          export PR_NUMBER=${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
-          python tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
+          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
+        run: python tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py
